meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与参考图对比，并检查设计系统、功能正确性和文字显示问题，最终给出“通过”或“不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了网页界面或终端界面，并声称完成时，或者当你询问某个页面、组件或终端界面看起来是否正确时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下这个新做的登录页面，看看有没有视觉问题。
say.note: Claude 会截取页面截图，与参考图对比，并运行检查。

say.text: 这个终端界面的边框对齐吗？文字有没有溢出？
say.note: Claude 会捕获终端输出，检查对齐和溢出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA on any UI you build or modify. It captures screenshots, compares them with references, and checks design system, functionality, and CJK text issues, then gives a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you build or change any web or terminal UI and claim it's done, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

say_en.text: Check this new login page for visual issues.
say_en.note: Claude will capture screenshots, compare with reference, and run checks.

say_en.text: Are the borders of this terminal UI aligned? Any text overflow?
say_en.note: Claude will capture terminal output and check alignment and overflow.
